Problem Statement:
Given N strings and a prefix string p. Find how many of the N strings have p as their prefix. For example: String[] input={'100','111','10100','10','1111'} prefix='10' output=2
output_spec:
=2

Input Description:
Input Size : N <= 100000, string length <=1000, prefix length <=100
